  payment = record.credit_move_id.move_id.payment_id or record.debit_move_id.move_id.payment_id
  inbound_payment = payment.payment_type == 'inbound'

  return {

def _get_amount_usd(amount):
  exchange_rate = record.currency_exchange_rate if record.currency_exchange_rate >= 1 else 0
  amount_usd = amount
  
  # Bill in USD Currency
  if record.currency_id.name == 'USD':
    amount_per_qty_usd = record.currency_id.round(amount_usd / line.quantity) if line.quantity and amount_usd else 0
    amount_home_currency = record.currency_id.round(amount * exchange_rate)
    amount_per_qty_home_currency = record.currency_id.round(amount_home_currency / line.quantity) if line.quantity and amount_home_currency else 0
    return record.currency_id.round(amount_usd), amount_per_qty_usd, amount_home_currency, amount_per_qty_home_currency

  # Bill Currency to USD Currency
  amount_usd =  record.currency_id.round(amount / exchange_rate) if exchange_rate else 0
  amount_per_qty_usd = record.currency_id.round(amount_usd / line.quantity) if line.quantity and amount_usd else 0
  amount_home_currency = amount
  amount_per_qty_home_currency = record.currency_id.round(amount_home_currency / line.quantity) if line.quantity and amount_home_currency else 0
  # log(str(amount_usd), level='amount_usd')
  return amount_usd, amount_per_qty_usd, amount_home_currency, amount_per_qty_home_currency

def _get_total_section(house, lines, sequence):
  section_lines = []
  section_total = 0
  line_section = 0
  seq = sequence
  for line in lines:
    if not line.get('display_type'):
      section_total += float(line.get("Amount_in_float", 0))
    elif line.get("display_type") == 'line_section' and section_total > 0:
      section_lines.append(_create_section_total(section_total, seq))
      line_section += 1
      seq += 1
      section_total = 0
    section_lines.append(line)
    line['sequence'] = seq
    seq += 1
  if section_total > 0 and line_section > 1:
    section_lines.append(_create_section_total(section_total, seq))
    seq += 1
  return {'line': section_lines,'seq' : seq}

def _get_running_detention(job_id, container_registry_id, field, detention_id=False):
  domain = [('nvocc_service_job_id', '=', job_id.id), ('advance_detention', '=', True), ('container_id', '=', container_registry_id.id)]
  if detention_id:
    domain.append(('id' , '<=', detention_id.id))
  adv_detention = env['nvocc.detention.charge'].search(domain)
  amount = adv_detention and sum(adv_detention.mapped(field)) or 0
  return amount

def _get_running_detention(job_id, container_registry_id, field, detention_id=False):
  domain = [('nvocc_service_job_id', '=', job_id.id), ('advance_detention', '=', True), ('container_id', '=', container_registry_id.id)]
  if detention_id:
    domain.append(('id' , '<=', detention_id.id))
  adv_detention = env['nvocc.detention.charge'].search(domain)
  amount = adv_detention and sum(adv_detention.mapped(field)) or 0
  return amount 

def _parse_line_data(line):
  currency_exchange_rate = 1
  pre_adv_amount = 0
  if line.service_job_charge_currency_id != env.company.currency_id:
    # currency_exchange_rate = line.currency_exchange_rate
      currency_exchange_rate =  line.nvocc_detention_charge_id and line.nvocc_detention_charge_id.amount_conversion_rate or line.currency_exchange_rate   
  # if currency_exchange_rate > 1:
  # currency_exchange_rate =float( '% 0.2f' % (currency_exchange_rate))
  vat =  (line.price_total - line.price_subtotal) * currency_exchange_rate
  subtotal = (line.quantity * line.price_unit)
  subtotal = round(subtotal, 2)
  if line.nvocc_detention_charge_id and line.nvocc_detention_charge_id.advance_detention:
    pre_adv_amount += _get_running_detention(line.nvocc_service_job_id, line.container_registry_id, 'total_currency_amount', line.nvocc_detention_charge_id)
    pre_adv_amount -= line.nvocc_detention_charge_id.total_currency_amount
  total_amount = '% 0.2f' % (float(vat) + float(subtotal))
  total_currency_amount = ((line.charge_rate_per_unit * line.quantity) + pre_adv_amount) * currency_exchange_rate
  discount =  line.discount and (line.quantity * line.charge_rate_per_unit * line.discount)/100 or 0
  charge_rate_per_unit = line.charge_rate_per_unit and line.charge_rate_per_unit or line.price_unit
  fc_discount = line.discount and (line.quantity * charge_rate_per_unit * line.discount)/100 or 0
  container = line.nvocc_detention_charge_id and line.nvocc_detention_charge_id.container_id and line.nvocc_detention_charge_id.container_id.name or ''
  ctype = line.nvocc_detention_charge_id and line.nvocc_detention_charge_id.container_type_id and line.nvocc_detention_charge_id.container_type_id.code or ''
  log_days = line.nvocc_detention_charge_id and line.nvocc_detention_charge_id.log_days or 0
  free_days = line.nvocc_detention_charge_id and line.nvocc_detention_charge_id.free_days or 0
  running_detention = line.advance_detention_charge_id and line.advance_detention_charge_id.total_currency_amount or 0
  local_running_detention = line.advance_detention_charge_id and line.advance_detention_charge_id.total_amount or 0 
  if line.nvocc_service_job_id and line.advance_detention_charge_id:
    if line.service_job_charge_currency_id != env.company.currency_id:
      running_detention = _get_running_detention(line.nvocc_service_job_id, line.container_registry_id, 'total_amount_after_discount')
      local_running_detention = _get_running_detention(line.nvocc_service_job_id, line.container_registry_id, 'total_amount')
    else:
      running_detention = _get_running_detention(line.nvocc_service_job_id, line.container_registry_id, 'total_currency_amount')
      local_running_detention = _get_running_detention(line.nvocc_service_job_id, line.container_registry_id, 'total_amount')
  
  amount_currency = line.advance_detention_charge_id and line.advance_detention_charge_id.amount_currency_id and line.advance_detention_charge_id.amount_currency_id.name or '' 
  fc_amount = 0 
  if line.service_job_charge_currency_id != env.company.currency_id:
    fc_amount = line.charge_rate_per_unit * line.quantity
    fc_amount += pre_adv_amount
    fc_amount_net_total = fc_amount * line.currency_exchange_rate
    running_detention_net_total = running_detention * line.advance_detention_charge_id.amount_conversion_rate
    discount_net_total = discount * line.currency_exchange_rate
    subtotal_val = ((fc_amount_net_total - discount_net_total - running_detention_net_total))
  else:
    discount =  line.discount and (line.quantity * line.charge_rate_per_unit * line.discount * currency_exchange_rate)/100 or 0
    subtotal_val = (total_currency_amount - discount - local_running_detention)
  return {
    "product_id": line.product_id and line.product_id.name or '',
    "name": line.name,
    "quantity": line.quantity ,
    'price_unit' : "{:,.2f}".format(line.charge_rate_per_unit),
    'subtotal' : "{:,.2f}".format(subtotal),
    'invoice_total' : "{:,.2f}".format(line.charge_rate_per_unit * line.quantity),
    'service_job_charge_currency_id' : line.service_job_charge_currency_id and line.service_job_charge_currency_id.name or '',
    "symbol":  line.service_job_charge_currency_id and line.service_job_charge_currency_id.symbol or '',
    "currency_exchange_rate": "{:,.2f}".format(currency_exchange_rate),
    "exchange_total" : "{:,.2f}".format(total_currency_amount),
    "charge_rate_per_unit": "{:,.2f}".format(line.charge_rate_per_unit) or "",
    #"tax_ids": line.tax_ids and ", "join(line.mapped('tax_ids').mapped('name')) or '',
    "vat": line.tax_ids and ", ".join(line.tax_ids.mapped('display_name')) or '',
    'sub_total' : "{:,.2f}".format(subtotal_val),
    'discount' : "{:,.2f}".format(discount),
    'container' : container,
    'ctype' : ctype,
    'currency_id' : line.currency_id and line.currency_id.name or '', 
    'fc_discount' : "{:,.2f}".format(fc_discount),
    'fc_amount' : "{:,.2f}".format(fc_amount),
    'log_days' : log_days,
    'running_detention': "{:,.2f}".format(running_detention),
    'free_days' : free_days,
    'amount_currency_id' : amount_currency,
    'total_log_days' : _get_running_detention(line.nvocc_service_job_id, line.container_registry_id, 'log_days', line.nvocc_detention_charge_id), 
    # 'total_free_days' : _get_running_detention(line.nvocc_service_job_id, line.container_registry_id, 'free_days', line.nvocc_detention_charge_id),
    'free_days' : free_days,
  }

def _get_running_detention(job_id, container_registry_id, field, detention_id=False):
  domain = [('nvocc_service_job_id', '=', job_id.id), ('advance_detention', '=', True), ('container_id', '=', container_registry_id.id)]
  if detention_id:
    domain.append(('id' , '<=', detention_id.id))
  adv_detention = env['nvocc.detention.charge'].search(domain)
  amount = adv_detention and sum(adv_detention.mapped(field)) or 0
  return amount

def _get_exchange_rate_other_charges(other_charges_obj):
    usd = env.ref("base.USD")
    pkr = env.ref("base.PKR")
    usd_currency_id = env['res.currency'].search([('id', '=', usd.id)], limit=1)
    pkr_currency_id = env['res.currency'].search([('id', '=', pkr.id)], limit=1)
    if (currency_id == pkr_currency_id and other_charges_obj.currency_id == pkr_currency_id) or (
            currency_id == usd_currency_id and other_charges_obj.currency_id == usd_currency_id):
        return 1
    elif (currency_id == pkr_currency_id and other_charges_obj.currency_id == usd_currency_id) or (
            currency_id == usd_currency_id and other_charges_obj.currency_id == pkr_currency_id):
        if other_charges_obj.move_id.currency_exchange_rate and other_charges_obj.move_id.currency_exchange_rate > 1:
            return other_charges_obj.move_id.currency_exchange_rate
        else:
            usd = env.ref("base.USD")
            currency = env['res.currency'].sudo().with_context(company_id=other_charges_obj.company_id.id).search(
                [('id', '=', usd.id)], limit=1)
            return 1 / ((currency and currency.rate) or 1)

def _get_other_charges(other_charges_objs):
    other_charges_list = []
    usd = env.ref("base.USD")
    pkr = env.ref("base.PKR")
    usd_currency_id = env['res.currency'].search([('id', '=', usd.id)], limit=1)
    pkr_currency_id = env['res.currency'].search([('id', '=', pkr.id)], limit=1)
    for other_charges_obj in other_charges_objs:
        exchange_rate = _get_exchange_rate_other_charges(other_charges_obj)
        if currency_id == usd_currency_id and other_charges_obj.currency_id == pkr_currency_id:
            credit_amount = (other_charges_obj.price_subtotal / exchange_rate)
            price = other_charges_obj.price_unit
        elif currency_id == pkr_currency_id and other_charges_obj.currency_id == usd_currency_id:
            credit_amount = (other_charges_obj.price_subtotal * exchange_rate)
            price = other_charges_obj.price_unit
        else:
            credit_amount = (other_charges_obj.price_subtotal)
            price = other_charges_obj.price_unit
        other_charges_list.append({
            'charge': other_charges_obj.name or '',
            'job': '',
            'hbl_number': '',
            'currency': other_charges_obj.currency_id.name or '',
            'charge_currency_id': "",
            'company_currency_id': env.company.currency_id.name,
            'wizard_currency_id': currency_id.name if currency_id else "Test Wizard",
            'quantity': other_charges_obj.quantity,
            'invoice_type': 'Other',
            'commission_amount': 0.00,
            'margin': 0.00,
            'exchange_rate': exchange_rate,
            'price': price or 0.00,
            'debit': 0.0,
            'credit': credit_amount or 0.00,
            'move_name': other_charges_obj.move_id.name,
        })
    return other_charges_list


def _get_exchange_rate_payble_receivable(principal_charge):
    usd = env.ref("base.USD")
    pkr = env.ref("base.PKR")
    usd_currency_id = env['res.currency'].search([('id', '=', usd.id)], limit=1)
    pkr_currency_id = env['res.currency'].search([('id', '=', pkr.id)], limit=1)

    if currency_id == pkr_currency_id and principal_charge.amount_currency_id == pkr_currency_id:
        return 1
    if currency_id == pkr_currency_id and principal_charge.amount_currency_id == usd_currency_id:
        return principal_charge.amount_conversion_rate
    if currency_id == usd_currency_id and principal_charge.amount_currency_id == usd_currency_id:
        return 1
    if currency_id == usd_currency_id and principal_charge.amount_currency_id == pkr_currency_id:
        service_job_id = principal_charge.nvocc_service_job_id
        vessel_schedule_id = env['freight.schedule'].search([
            ('vessel_id', '=', service_job_id.vessel_id.id),
            ('voyage_number', '=', service_job_id.voyage_id.name)
        ], limit=1)
        if vessel_schedule_id and vessel_schedule_id.exchange_rate > 1:
            return vessel_schedule_id.exchange_rate
        else:
            usd = env.ref("base.USD")
            currency = env['res.currency'].sudo().with_context(company_id=principal_charge.company_id.id).search(
                [('id', '=', usd.id)], limit=1)
            return 1 / ((currency and currency.rate) or 1)


def _get_payable_receivable_charges(principal_charges):
    payable_receivable_charges_list = []
    usd = env.ref("base.USD")
    pkr = env.ref("base.PKR")
    usd_currency_id = env['res.currency'].search([('id', '=', usd.id)], limit=1)
    pkr_currency_id = env['res.currency'].search([('id', '=', pkr.id)], limit=1)
    for principal_charge in principal_charges:
        exchange_rate = _get_exchange_rate_payble_receivable(principal_charge)
        if currency_id == usd_currency_id and principal_charge.amount_currency_id == pkr_currency_id:
            debit_amount = (
                        principal_charge.total_amount_after_discount / exchange_rate) if principal_charge.invoice_type == 'payable' else 0.0
            credit_amount = (
                        principal_charge.total_amount_after_discount / exchange_rate) if principal_charge.invoice_type == 'receivable' else 0.0
            margin = (principal_charge.margin * principal_charge.quantity) / exchange_rate
            commission_amount = principal_charge.commission_amount / exchange_rate
            price = principal_charge.total_amount_after_discount
        elif currency_id == pkr_currency_id and principal_charge.amount_currency_id == usd_currency_id:
            debit_amount = (
                        principal_charge.total_amount_after_discount * exchange_rate) if principal_charge.invoice_type == 'payable' else 0.0
            credit_amount = (
                        principal_charge.total_amount_after_discount * exchange_rate) if principal_charge.invoice_type == 'receivable' else 0.0
            margin = (principal_charge.margin * principal_charge.quantity) * exchange_rate
            commission_amount = principal_charge.commission_amount * exchange_rate
            price = principal_charge.total_amount_after_discount
        else:
            debit_amount = (
                principal_charge.total_amount_after_discount) if principal_charge.invoice_type == 'payable' else 0.0
            credit_amount = (
                principal_charge.total_amount_after_discount) if principal_charge.invoice_type == 'receivable' else 0.0
            margin = principal_charge.margin * principal_charge.quantity
            commission_amount = principal_charge.commission_amount
            price = principal_charge.total_amount_after_discount
        payable_receivable_charges_list.append({
            'charge': principal_charge.product_id.name or '',
            'job': principal_charge.nvocc_service_job_id.name or '',
            'hbl_number': principal_charge.nvocc_service_job_id.hbl_number or '',
            'currency': principal_charge.amount_currency_id.name or '',
            'invoice_type': principal_charge.invoice_type or '',
            'charge_currency_id': principal_charge.amount_currency_id.name or '',
            'wizard_currency_id': currency_id.name if currency_id else "Test Wizard",
            'company_currency_id': env.company.currency_id.id,
            'quantity': principal_charge.quantity or 0.0,
            'commission_amount': commission_amount,
            'margin': margin,
            'exchange_rate': exchange_rate,
            'charge_exchange_rate': principal_charge.amount_conversion_rate,
            'price': price,
            'debit': debit_amount,
            'credit': credit_amount,
            'move_name': '',
        })

    return payable_receivable_charges_list

                    <field name="account_internal_type" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="partner_id" can_create="true" can_write="true" modifiers="{}"/>
                    <field name="journal_id" can_create="true" can_write="true" modifiers="{"readonly": true}"/>
                    <field name="move_id" string="Journal Entry" filter_domain="[                         '|', '|', ('move_id.name', 'ilike', self), ('move_id.ref', 'ilike', self), ('move_id.partner_id', 'ilike', self)]" on_change="1" can_create="true" can_write="true" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "required": true}"/>
